goal_source: Git Crafter goal: pages.yml publishes on every push to main (its build job's timeout is 15 minutes), so no merge waits once its run ends; near: one or two merges inside a running publish

params.comment: Git Crafter ships GitHub Pages, read by deploy-pages.mjs through the GitHub API, in CI as well. Every merge to main counts as shipping.
